semanticPatterns.name: neutral
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate ordered neutral surfaces, boundaries, and inverse relationships in both themes without copying fixed mappings.

semanticPatterns.name: primary-brand
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate a complete primary interaction relationship set while keeping product action separate from future brand expression.

semanticPatterns.name: secondary
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate supporting emphasis and interaction states only if a distinct product responsibility is demonstrated.

semanticPatterns.name: tertiary
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Compare tertiary, accent, and muted responsibilities before adding a third emphasis tier.

semanticPatterns.name: success
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate complete success relationships, including foreground and boundary obligations plus non-color cues.

semanticPatterns.name: warning
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate warning relationships independently from error, destructive, pending, and informational states.

semanticPatterns.name: danger
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate destructive danger separately from validation error before deciding whether they share mappings.

semanticPatterns.name: text
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Evaluate ordered text emphasis and inverse pairs on every permitted surface with explicit contrast obligations.

semanticPatterns.name: alpha
semanticPatterns.interfaceOSRequirement: Define compositing responsibilities and transparent endpoints without adopting external opacity percentages or source colors.
